source_status: NA28 is the user-authorized provisional New Testament base. Focused checks of the German Bible Society’s Greek running text are recorded by chapter. This is an English editorial revision, not complete critical-text or apparatus verification. The newer Bespoke PDF’s preferred UBS6 text has not been obtained; UBS6/ECM comparison, full apparatus, independent Greek and human read-aloud reviews remain pending.

verses.text: The elder, to the chosen lady and her children, whom I love in truth—and not I alone, but also all who have come to know the truth—
verses.display_text: The elder, to the chosen lady and her children, whom I love in truth—and not I alone, but also all who have come to know the truth—

verses.text: because of the truth that abides in us and will be with us forever:
verses.display_text: because of the truth that abides in us and will be with us forever:

verses.text: Grace, mercy, and peace will be with us from God the Father and from Jesus Christ, the Son of the Father, in truth and love.
verses.display_text: Grace, mercy, and peace will be with us from God the Father and from Jesus Christ, the Son of the Father, in truth and love.

verses.text: I rejoiced greatly that I have found some of your children walking in truth, just as we received a commandment from the Father.
verses.display_text: I rejoiced greatly that I have found some of your children walking in truth, just as we received a commandment from the Father.

verses.text: And now I ask you, lady—not as though writing you a new commandment, but the one we had from the beginning—that we love one another.
verses.display_text: And now I ask you, lady—not as though writing you a new commandment, but the one we had from the beginning—that we love one another.

verses.text: And this is love: that we walk according to His commandments. This is the commandment, just as you all heard from the beginning: that you walk in it.
verses.display_text: And this is love: that we walk according to His commandments. This is the commandment, just as you all heard from the beginning: that you walk in it.

verses.text: For many deceivers have gone out into the world, those who do not confess Jesus Christ coming in the flesh. Such a person is the deceiver and the antichrist.
verses.display_text: For many deceivers have gone out into the world, those who do not confess Jesus Christ coming in the flesh. Such a person is the deceiver and the antichrist.

verses.text: Watch yourselves, so that you do not lose what we have worked for, but receive a full reward.
verses.display_text: Watch yourselves, so that you do not lose what we have worked for, but receive a full reward.

verses.text: Everyone who goes ahead and does not abide in the teaching of Christ does not have God. Whoever abides in the teaching has both the Father and the Son.
verses.display_text: Everyone who goes ahead and does not abide in the teaching of Christ does not have God. Whoever abides in the teaching has both the Father and the Son.

verses.text: If anyone comes to you and does not bring this teaching, do not receive him into a house, and do not offer him a greeting,
verses.display_text: If anyone comes to you and does not bring this teaching, do not receive him into a house, and do not offer him a greeting,

verses.text: for whoever offers him a greeting shares in his evil works.
verses.display_text: for whoever offers him a greeting shares in his evil works.

verses.text: Although I have many things to write to you all, I did not wish to do so with paper and ink. Instead, I hope to come to you and speak face to face, so that our joy may be made full.
verses.display_text: Although I have many things to write to you all, I did not wish to do so with paper and ink. Instead, I hope to come to you and speak face to face, so that our joy may be made full.

verses.text: The children of your chosen sister greet you.
verses.display_text: The children of your chosen sister greet you.
